'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Nicolae Borota DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nicolae Borota]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Nicolae Borota (JediBorota)
* '''Deck name:''' Darkbringer
* '''Username:''' JediBorota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
